name: animated-gradient-text
description: An animated gradient background which transitions between colors for text.
install: Install the component using your preferred package manager: pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add "https://magicui.design/r/animated-gradient-text.json" or npm/npx: npx shadcn@latest add "https://magicui.design/r/animated-gradient-text.json" or yarn: yarn dlx shadcn@latest add "https://magicui.design/r/animated-gradient-text.json" or bun: bunx shadcn@latest add "https://magicui.design/r/animated-gradient-text.json". After installation, you can import the component like this: import { AnimatedGradientText } from "@/components/ui/animated-gradient-text";
